description: The draft-critic lens's whole verdict on one drafted artifact.

sound.description: Whether the draft satisfies the task as it stands: true only when no blocking or significant finding remains.
sound.title: Sound

findings.description: Every defect found, unfiltered by severity or confidence; empty when the draft is sound.

items.description: One defect the fresh-context critic found in a drafted artifact.

quotedPassage.description: The offending passage, quoted from the draft so the reader can locate it without re-deriving the finding.
quotedPassage.title: Quotedpassage

defect.description: What is wrong with that passage, stated as a defect.
defect.title: Defect

severity.description: blocking: the draft cannot be acted on. significant: it can, but the result will miss the task. minor: everything else.
severity.title: CritiqueSeverity

confidence.description: How sure you are the defect is real, from 0 to 1. Report low confidence rather than filtering — routing downstream decides.
confidence.title: Confidence

items.title: CritiqueFinding

findings.title: Findings

sherlockFlags.description: Findings about why the draft's parts exist rather than whether they work; empty when nothing warrants a supervisor's attention.

items.description:
One thing the critic flags for a supervisor's attention.

The channel the persona rewrite had to preserve: a finding about WHY a
component exists rather than whether it works — over-implementation,
machinery no measured failure justifies, a goal quietly substituted.
It is a typed, routable item because a flag that cannot be routed is a
persona artefact with a new name.

Distinct from the accept gate's ``SherlockFlag``, which anchors to a
criterion id: this one anchors to a passage of a drafted artifact,
which has no criteria yet.  Same wire field name on two producers,
two anchors, one definition each.

subject.description: What is flagged: the component, claim, or decision the supervisor should look at, named precisely enough to find.
subject.title: Subject

reason.description: Why it is flagged: the measured failure that would justify it and is absent, or the goal it serves that the task never asked for.
reason.title: Reason

items.title: CritiqueFlag
